name: tesla-quarterly-deliveries
title: Tesla quarterly vehicle production and deliveries by model group
description: Vehicles produced and delivered per quarter by reported model group, from Q2 2019 to Q2 2026 (29 quarters, 174 rows), taken from Exhibit 99.1 of Tesla's quarterly Production & Deliveries Form 8-K filed with the SEC. Tesla reports grouped models, not individual ones, and the grouping has changed twice (Model S/X + Model 3 → Model S/X + Model 3/Y → Model 3/Y + Other Models); groups are kept exactly as reported and are never split or re-combined. Each quarter carries its component rows plus the reported Total, flagged by is_total — do not sum a Total row with its components. Coverage starts at Q2 2019 because that is the first release to publish a table; the 20 earlier releases back to Q1 2013 state their figures in prose only and are listed in source-filings.csv as discovered but not extracted. Missing values are empty cells and are distinct from a genuine 0 (Tesla produced no Model S/X in Q1 2021). Snapshot taken 2026-09-18; rebuilt offline by build.ts from the archived filings.

resources.name: tesla-quarterly-deliveries

fields.name: period_start
fields.description: First day of the reported calendar quarter.

fields.name: period_end
fields.description: Last day of the reported calendar quarter.

fields.name: vehicle_group
fields.description: Model grouping exactly as the release labels it: Model S/X, Model 3, Model 3/Y, Other Models, or Total. Tesla does not report individual models, and a combined group is never split here. Which groups appear changes over time — see README.md.

fields.name: is_total
fields.description: true for the release's own Total row, false for a component row. The components of one quarter and metric sum to its Total; summing a Total with its components double-counts.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: production (vehicles built) or deliveries (vehicles transferred to a customer with paperwork complete). Tesla reports these as two separate measures; they are never equal and neither is revenue.

fields.name: vehicles
fields.description: Vehicle count as reported. Empty means the release did not give a figure; 0 means it reported none built or delivered (Model S/X production in Q1 2021). Deliveries figures are described by Tesla as slightly conservative and subject to revision of up to about 0.5%.

fields.name: source_id
fields.description: SEC accession number of the 8-K the figure was read from; joins to source-filings.csv.

fields.name: period_start

fields.name: vehicle_group
fields.description: Model grouping exactly as the release labels it, on the same terms as the quarterly resource.

fields.name: is_total
fields.description: true for the release's own Total row, false for a component row.

fields.name: metric
fields.description: production or deliveries, as in the quarterly resource.

fields.name: vehicles
fields.description: Vehicle count for the full year as recapped in the Q4 release. This is not always the sum of the four quarters as first reported — Tesla restates — so the two resources are kept separate rather than reconciled. See README.md.

fields.name: source_id

fields.name: filing_date

fields.name: period_label

fields.name: layout
fields.description: table where the figures are in an HTML table and were extracted; prose where the release states them in narrative text only; not-a-production-and-deliveries-release for an exhibit filed in the same window that is something else.

fields.name: extracted
